text:
Sasha (People Ops): Quick Q — Marta had a medical emergency overseas and paid out of pocket. She submitted the receipts but asking whether company covers the excess after her personal travel insurance paid. What docs do we need?

Marta (Product): Thanks — yes I had to use local ER, paid ~€1,200, my travel insurer covered €800. I uploaded scans to Expensify and added the insurer EOB PDF. Do I need anything else?

Liam (Finance): Short answer: we can reimburse covered business-related portions and emergency costs if within policy. Need: itemized receipts, insurer Explanation of Benefits (EOB), a short incident note, and manager sign-off. Also need to confirm trip was company-approved.

Priya (Legal): Also confirm no subrogation/conflict with insurer terms. If insurer reimbursed the same line items, we must avoid double-pay. Provide the EOB showing amounts paid. If employee waived reimbursement from insurer, we need that in writing.

Sasha (People Ops): Thanks. Marta — can you drop the claim packet into this thread so Finance can route? Also do manager sign-off.

Marta (Product): Uploaded: "medical_receipts.pdf" and "insurer_EOB.pdf" to the expense. Manager (Ravi) approved in the approval flow. Do I fill any special form?

Liam (Finance): Please add a short note in the expense describing what happened (date/time, clinic name, treatment). We need a checkbox confirmation that charges are business-related (e.g., happened while on company travel). Example: 
```
Incident summary: Fell ill on 2026-03-15 in Lisbon, ER visit for dehydration, meds prescribed.
Total paid: €1,200; insurer paid €800 on 2026-03-20; outstanding €400 requested from company.
Attachments: itemized receipt, insurer EOB, manager approval.
```

Priya (Legal): If the insurer reimbursed the employee for the same €400 later, Finance will reconcile and may claw back. Please ensure the EOB clearly shows line-by-line.

Sasha (People Ops): Policy note for the record: emergency medical covered when travel is company-approved. Company covers reasonable out-of-pocket emergency costs not covered by personal insurance, up to policy limits. We require documentation within 60 days.

expense-bot: :white_check_mark: Expense submitted (ID: EXP-4821). Status: pending finance review.

Liam (Finance): I'll review today. If everything is present, reimbursement will be processed on next payroll run or as an off-cycle payment if urgent. Marta — if you prefer off-cycle, reply here and we'll expedite.

Marta (Product): Off-cycle please, travel card already hit personal card. Thanks! :pray:
